headlines.text: Back on this day in 2023, MJF vs. Jack Perry vs. Darby Allin vs. Sammy Guevara fought tooth and nail for the AEW World Heavyweight Title, appearing on Double or Nothing, rated 8.83 ? a genuine showstealer. Jack Perry was challenging for gold for the very first time. MJF revived his headlock finisher to pin an unconscious Darby Allin, retaining the AEW World Title over Allin, Sammy Guevara and Jack Perry in the first-ever four-way for the belt.

On a Wednesday in 2025, back when Gabe Kidd arrived in AEW against Jon Moxley vs. Marina Shafir vs. Mark Briscoe vs. Mike Bailey vs. Willow Nightingale, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.51 ? a solid showing. Gabe Kidd debuted alongside the Death Riders, helping Jon Moxley and Marina Shafir overpower Willow Nightingale, Mark Briscoe and Mike Bailey.
Turning the clock back to 2021: KiLynn King made their AEW debut against Jade Cargill, appearing on Dynamite, rated 3.79.

secondaries.text: 2023 brought us this moment: Castagnoli, Moxley & Yuta vs. The Elite vs. The Young Bucks vs. Bryan Danielson vs. Claudio Castagnoli vs. Jon Moxley vs. Wheeler Yuta vs. Matt Jackson vs. Nick Jackson vs. Kenny Omega vs. Adam Page fought it out in an Anarchy in the Arena match, in the show-closing main event slot on Double or Nothing, rated 8.74 ? an incredible outing, part of the special Double or Nothing '23 card. In a rematch of the previous year's chaotic brawl, Blackpool Combat Club overcame The Elite in Anarchy in the Arena when Moxley choked out Kenny Omega with a bulldog choke, a match that also revealed Konosuke Takeshita's heel turn to align with Don Callis.

Looking back to 2023, when Wardlow vs. Christian Cage fought tooth and nail for the AEW TNT Title in a Ladder match, appearing on Double or Nothing, rated 6.71. It was the 70th time the AEW TNT Title had been on the line, a genuinely rare milestone for that title. Wardlow retained the TNT Championship in a ladder match after Arn Anderson tipped the ladder Christian Cage was climbing, sending him falling right into a powerbomb.
Turning the clock back to 2023: FTR vs. Jarrett & Lethal fought tooth and nail for the AEW World Tag Team Titles, appearing on Double or Nothing, rated 6.36. FTR was chasing gold for the 10th time.
